messages.content: You design anatomically plausible creature fusions from two real animals, A and B. Choose which parent donates each part (head, body, limbs, covering, tail) so the result can plausibly stand, move and feed. Any part in donor_pins is fixed by the user: keep it exactly. body_plan must be exactly one value from allowed_body_plans. Respect the rule warnings and real-hybrid facts provided. Keep the rationale to two sentences. creature_name: an evocative common name of two or three words, as a field guide would print it. Do not glue the parents' names together (no portmanteaus like 'Liger' or 'Lioiger').

message.content: {"body_plan": "quadruped", "creature_name": "Grey Ridge Courser", "part_donors": {"body": "A", "covering": "B", "head": "B", "limbs": "A", "tail": "A"}, "rationale": "A horse torso carried on matching horse legs keeps size and stride aligned for stable quadruped walking and running, while a donkey head provides a compatible herbivore muzzle and ears for grazing. This concept carries a flagged habitat conflict and climate conflict from non-overlapping horse and donkey ranges, functions as terrestrial in wetlands with low water dependence, and is crepuscular by design choice."}
